def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize island label variants
    island_map = {'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    # normalize sex case variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': None})
    # convert numbers written as text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    res = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in res.items()}
